commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marc Bollengier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lorient.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lorient was in an offside position.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 3 Goal! Sambou Soumano (Lorient) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 3:3.
89' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) gets booked.
88' Romain Del Castillo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pathe Mboup (Brest).
86' 2 - 3 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yvon Mvogo into left side of the goal.
86' Referee Marc Bollengier is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Brest!
86' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Brest using VAR. Let's see what happens.
84' Bamo Meite (Lorient) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul. Brest are awarded a penalty kick!
84' Booking. Bamo Meite (Lorient) receives a caution from the referee.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Theo Le Bris walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
83' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Arsene Kouassi is replaced by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
81' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
80' Lorient keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
78' Substitution. Kenny Lala will be replaced by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).

75' Radoslaw Majecki makes a difficult save to deny Bamba Dieng (Lorient), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lorient are going to take it.
73' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bamba Dieng (Lorient) replacing Pablo Pagis.
72' Substitution. Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sambou Soumano.

71' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marc Bollengier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
70' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
67' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle as Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
66' 9:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Tousart (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Kamory Doumbia can be given a rest.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Dina Ebimbe leaves the pitch and Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) comes on.
64' Poor challenge! Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle.
62' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Jean-Victor Makengo and he is replaced by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
62' Lorient failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' One of the players from Lorient times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
60' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
58' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
58' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bamo Meite (Lorient) and blew his whistle.
55' 2 - 2 What a sweet header! Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) leaps high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box and scores with a trademark header low inside the right post.
51' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) argues with the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
51' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
51' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient). Marc Bollengier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
51' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
50' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
47' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner inside the left post of his own net.
44' The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
42' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Brest get a corner.
39' Unlucky! A great strike from Pablo Pagis (Lorient) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
37' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
34' 1 - 1 Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
33' Lorient quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

33' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Radoslaw Majecki keeps the ball out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lorient.
32' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hugo Magnetti (Brest) brought his opponent down.
28' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
25' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' The free kick will be taken by Pablo Pagis (Lorient).
23' Kenny Lala (Brest) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
22' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) sends a long ball in, but Yvon Mvogo comfortably gathers the ball.
21' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece.
20' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
18' Brest are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
12' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
11' Dangerous play by Brendan Chardonnet (Brest). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The game is interrupted. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' A pass by Kamory Doumbia (Brest) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' 1 - 0 What a hit! Theo Le Bris (Lorient) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
